name: ALRICH
recent: ALRICH 于2026年10月29日发出第23届常年股东大会通知，将于12月10日举行。公司于10月22日及8月28日公布截至2026年6月30日止财务期间的合并业绩，并两度公告提供财务援助。10月初董事局出现人事变动。
notable: 将于2026年12月10日举行第23届常年股东大会。
于2026年10月22日及8月28日公布截至2026年6月30日止财务期间的合并业绩。
于2026年10月6日公告董事局变动，涉及 Encik Yahya bin Razali。

ann.title: Consolidated results for the financial period ended 30/06/2026
Change in Boardroom - ENCIK YAHYA BIN RAZALI
Consolidated results for the financial period ended 30/06/2026

recent_en: ALRICH issued a notice for its 23rd Annual General Meeting on 29 October 2026, to be held on 10 December. The company released consolidated results for the financial period ended 30 June 2026 on 22 October and 28 August, and announced the provision of financial assistance twice. There was a boardroom change in early October.
notable_en: The 23rd Annual General Meeting will be held on 10 December 2026.
Consolidated results for the financial period ended 30 June 2026 were announced on 22 October and 28 August 2026.
A boardroom change involving Encik Yahya bin Razali was announced on 6 October 2026.
